d:
Special force agent Jill Valentine is fighting alone in the city against the horde of undead. But bad luck caught up to her and she is cornered with zombies behind her... Unable to fight back, Jill becomes another victim for the undead as they relentlessly abuse and corrupt her body. Turning a once respectable agent to a helpless girl whose body only be used and breed by the zombies....
